bus_routes: Located approximately 112 km from Hyderabad (via Medchal & Medak town) or 80 km via the Narsapur forest route. It is 18 km from Medak town.
TGRTC operates special buses from Hyderabad (JBS/MGBS) to Medak town, and local buses/autos run frequently from Medak town to the temple.
The temple can be reached by road from Hyderabad and Medak. TGRTC buses, private buses, taxis, and personal vehicles are commonly used to reach the temple.

railway.station: Akanapet Railway Station / Medak Railway Station
railway.distance: Akanapet Railway Station (19 km away) or Medak Railway Station (18 km away)

airport.name: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA), Shamshabad, Hyderabad

additional_railway_details: Akanapet Railway Station (19 km away) or Medak Railway Station (18 km away), which connects to Secunderabad.
Alternatively, Secunderabad Junction (110 km) is the major rail hub.
Kamareddy (60 km) and Secunderabad Junction (110 km) are additional rail connectivity points.
